terrain_course.formula: min(6.0, 1.0 + relief_p90_p10_ft / 40 + 4 * share(slope >= 5%)), requires >= 100 valid boundary-grid samples and gap share <= 50%
terrain_course.cap_reason: A boundary-grid read describes the property, not the routing — it cannot claim the precision of a routed hole profile, so it is capped at 6.0/10. Hole-level ingest always supersedes it.
